title: Interactive Rubik's Cube with Rotation Constraints
prompt:
Create a fully interactive 3x3 Rubik's Cube with face rotation animations, scramble, and solve tracking using Three.js. The entire application must be in a single HTML file.

## Three.js Import
Use this importmap in <head>:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
Then in <script type="module">:
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

## Scene Setup
- Background 0x1a1a2e.
- PerspectiveCamera at (5, 5, 5), looking at origin.
- OrbitControls enabled.
- Ambient light (0x556677, intensity 0.5), directional light (0xffffff, intensity 0.8) at (5, 10, 8), plus a fill light (0x445566, intensity 0.3) at (-5, -5, 5).

## Cube Construction
- 27 small cubes (cubies), each 0.95x0.95x0.95, arranged in a 3x3x3 grid centered at origin, with 0.05 gap between them.
- Each cubie face has the standard Rubik's colors:
  - +Y face (top): White (0xffffff)
  - -Y face (bottom): Yellow (0xffff00)
  - +X face (right): Red (0xff0000)
  - -X face (left): Orange (0xff8800)
  - +Z face (front): Green (0x00ff00)
  - -Z face (back): Blue (0x0000ff)
- Internal faces (not visible) are dark gray (0x222222).
- Each cubie face is a separate mesh or uses per-face materials (6 materials per cubie).
- Black edge lines on each cubie (EdgesGeometry + LineSegments).

## Face Rotation
- Rotation is animated (smooth 90° rotation over 300ms using easeInOutCubic).
- During rotation, group the 9 cubies of the selected layer into a temporary group, rotate the group, then unparent and update cubie positions.
- After rotation, update the internal color state array to track which color is on which face.
- Only one rotation can happen at a time (queue subsequent inputs).

## Keyboard Controls
- 'U' / Shift+'U': rotate top layer CW / CCW (looking from +Y).
- 'D' / Shift+'D': rotate bottom layer CW / CCW.
- 'R' / Shift+'R': rotate right layer CW / CCW.
- 'L' / Shift+'L': rotate left layer CW / CCW.
- 'F' / Shift+'F': rotate front layer CW / CCW.
- 'B' / Shift+'B': rotate back layer CW / CCW.
- Press 'S' to scramble: perform 20 random moves.
- Press 'Z' to undo last move.
- Press 'X' to reset to solved state.

## Solve Detection
- After each move, check if the cube is solved: each face has all 9 stickers of the same color.
- If solved, flash a congratulatory message and track solve time.

## HUD (id='hud')
- Moves (id='hud-moves'): total move count since last scramble
- Status (id='hud-status'): 'Solved' / 'Scrambled' / 'Solving'
- Last move (id='hud-last'): last performed move notation (e.g., "U", "R'", "F")
- Timer (id='hud-timer'): seconds since scramble, 1 decimal (0 if solved or not started)
- Scramble moves (id='hud-scramble'): number of scramble moves applied
- Animating (id='hud-animating'): 'Yes' or 'No'

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame:
- `moveCount`: number
- `status`: string ('Solved'|'Scrambled'|'Solving')
- `lastMove`: string
- `timer`: number (rounded to 1 decimal)
- `scrambleMoves`: number
- `isAnimating`: boolean
- `isSolved`: boolean
- `frameCount`: number
- `cubeValid`: boolean (all 27 cubies present, no NaN in positions)
- `faceColors`: {U: string, D: string, R: string, L: string, F: string, B: string} (dominant color per face, or 'mixed')

Ensure the animation loop updates __3D_STATE__ every frame before rendering.
physics_constraints: Each face rotation must be exactly 90°. Rotation must only affect the 9 cubies in the selected layer. Color state must be tracked correctly after each rotation. Solved state: each face has uniform color. Undo must exactly reverse the last move. Scramble must produce a non-solved state. No NaN in cubie positions. 27 cubies must always be present.
